operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to use MySQL for the new service.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the new service architecture coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I revisited the database choice. Earlier, I planned to use MySQL for the new service.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Did the design change after comparing the available feature sets?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. I now plan to use Postgres for the new service because of that feature-set comparison.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Have you captured the decision somewhere for the team?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the choice is recorded in the ADR.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier MySQL plan and retain the current Postgres plan and its rationale.
